text.heroTitle: Help Us Build What Your Clinic Needs Next
text.introText: Tell us what would make running your clinic easier, or vote for an idea that's already here. The most-requested ideas rise to the top, and that's how we decide what to build.
text.detailsPlaceholder: What would this help you or your clients do?
text.emptyList: No ideas yet. Be the first: tell us what would help your clinic.
text.firstToSuggest: You're the first to suggest this. Share the board with the practitioners at your clinic; every vote moves it up the list.
text.loginNote: For the {name} team only. Enter the admin password to continue.
